steps.name: Given "company1" is provisioned as a disposable COMPANY target
And "company1" stores their current token as "company_active_token"
And "influencer1" is provisioned as a disposable INFLUENCER target
And "influencer1" stores their current token as "influencer_active_token"
And "admin1" is signed in as the administrator
Then soft assert "company1" using stored token "company_active_token" calling "/users/me" returns 401

"company1" stored token "company_active_token" GET /users/me — BE source expects 401, mock-session collapse accepts {401,419}; got 401; body: {"timestamp":"2026-09-10T17:36:23.404","status":401,"error":"Unauthorized","message":"Account has been disabled","path":"/api/users/me","requestId":"REQ-43534c1a"}

"company1" refresh should be rejected (error.auth.account_disabled); got 401; body: {"timestamp":"2026-09-10T17:36:23.415","status":401,"error":"Unauthorized","message":"Account has been disabled","path":"/api/auth/refresh-session","requestId":"REQ-70d6e7a4"}
